description: Every Noita creature, one row each. Stage 1 = all of them in Terraria.

name_en.desc: English name (fallback when Noita's translation file is missing).

name_key.desc: Key in Noita's data/translations/common.csv for the localized name.

faction.desc: Noita faction (herd). Same faction does not fight each other.

noita_hp.desc: Health as Noita displays it (internal hp x 25).

sprite.desc: Sprite XML inside data.wak (from the entity's SpriteComponent image_file).

hitbox.desc: [width, height] in Terraria pixels (Noita pixels x 3).

size.desc: Author's size multiplier on top of the Noita-to-Terraria scale (sprite and hitbox); 1 = Noita proportions.

hitbox_mult.desc: Author's multiplier on the hitbox only (sprite unchanged); 1 = Noita's hitbox.

fly_up_speed.desc: Max climb speed when flying, Terraria pixels/frame (fly_speed_max_up).

accel.desc: Share of the gap to target speed closed per frame (accel_x, 0..1).

jump_speed.desc: Jump launch speed, Terraria pixels/frame (PathFindingComponent jump_speed).

sight_tiles.desc: Notices the player within this many tiles (creature_detection_range_x).

audio.desc: Folder of the creature's Noita sound events (AudioComponent event_root, e.g. animals/zombie): its jump, damage/projectile and death sounds; 'none' if Noita has none.

spawn_in.desc: Noita locations it spawns in (natural spawns only).

spawn_rule.desc: How it enters a Terraria world.

tier.desc: Progression tier: scales hp and damage.

dmg_mult.desc: Damage taken multiplier per Noita damage type.

blood.desc: Material it bleeds (used by stage 2 physics).

stage.desc: 1a = first slice, 1b = all regular enemies, 1c = bosses, minions and special.
